response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong web, backend, and tooling credentials, but the profile does not align with this embedded networking security role. There is no evidence of Japanese language ability (a hard native-level requirement), no Linux kernel source analysis/modification experience, no networking security work (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal), and no L2/L3 switching or chip-vendor SDK exposure. C experience is limited and dated (roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus a university thesis), while the last decade has been almost entirely JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, and cloud/web platforms. The gap on the mandatory qualifications is too large to bridge in screening.
strengths: 15+ years of software development across many domains and stacks
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, open-source authorship
Some low-level exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux/JACK audio thesis)
concerns: No evidence of Japanese proficiency; native-level is a hard requirement
No Linux kernel analysis/modification or embedded firmware experience
No networking security (MACsec, 802.1X) or L2/L3 switch background; C skills dated

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel / embedded networking security experience
Senior breadth and strong engineering practices
